scripts.xcode: mkdir -p src-tauri/gen/apple/Externals/arm64/Debug src-tauri/gen/apple/Externals/arm64/Release && cp src-tauri/target/aarch64-apple-ios-sim/debug/deps/libpeek_save_lib.a src-tauri/gen/apple/Externals/arm64/Debug/libapp.a 2>/dev/null || true && cp src-tauri/target/aarch64-apple-ios/release/deps/libpeek_save_lib.a src-tauri/gen/apple/Externals/arm64/Release/libapp.a 2>/dev/null || true && open src-tauri/gen/apple/peek-save.xcodeproj
scripts.clean:rust: cd src-tauri && rm -rf target/aarch64-apple-ios-sim/debug/build/peek-save-* target/aarch64-apple-ios/release/build/peek-save-* 2>/dev/null; touch build.rs; echo 'Rust bridge cache cleaned'
scripts.clean:rust:full: cd src-tauri && rm -rf target/aarch64-apple-ios-sim/debug/deps target/aarch64-apple-ios-sim/debug/build target/aarch64-apple-ios-sim/debug/.fingerprint target/aarch64-apple-ios/release/deps target/aarch64-apple-ios/release/build target/aarch64-apple-ios/release/.fingerprint 2>/dev/null; echo 'Full Rust cache cleaned'
scripts.clean:ios:sim: cd src-tauri && rm -rf target/aarch64-apple-ios-sim/debug/build/peek-save-* 2>/dev/null; touch build.rs; echo 'iOS simulator cache cleaned'
scripts.clean:ios:device: cd src-tauri && rm -rf target/aarch64-apple-ios/release/build/peek-save-* 2>/dev/null; touch build.rs; echo 'iOS device cache cleaned'
scripts.deploy:sim: node -e "const f='BUILD_NUMBER';require('fs').writeFileSync(f,String(+require('fs').readFileSync(f,'utf-8').trim()+1)+'\n')" && ./build-ios.sh --force && npm run xcode:build && npm run sim:install && npm run sim:launch
scripts.sim:launch: xcrun simctl terminate booted com.dietrich.peek-mobile 2>/dev/null; xcrun simctl launch booted com.dietrich.peek-mobile
scripts.sim:log: xcrun simctl spawn booted log stream --predicate 'process == "Peek Save"' --level debug
scripts.sim:log:webview: xcrun simctl spawn booted log stream --predicate 'process == "Peek Save" AND eventMessage CONTAINS "webview"' --style compact
scripts.xcode:clean: cd src-tauri/gen/apple && xcodebuild -scheme peek-save_iOS -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath /tmp/peek-xcodebuild-sim -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' clean
scripts.xcode:build: rm -rf /tmp/peek-xcodebuild-sim && cd src-tauri/gen/apple && xcodebuild -scheme peek-save_iOS -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath /tmp/peek-xcodebuild-sim -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' clean build
